role: final pre-integration verification gate (MENSURA_BENCH_V2 section 8.5 item 1)

stage1_zero_knob_vs_hand_picked.evidence: 5/5 cases: auto-selected (k0, iterations, k) equal the round-2 hand-picked values and the resulting brackets are bit-identical (shell_diff=0, gp_diff=0). Perturbation probe (seed change, n +/- 10%): 13/15 rows contain truth; two benign k flips (square n=1440: 4->6, refutation n=1440: 10->8) with bracket midpoint shifts <= 0.021 and containment kept.
stage1_zero_knob_vs_hand_picked.fragility: The 1000:1 family only: seed=12 contains 2.0 by 0.009; n=1440 MISSES by 0.090 (a second scratch calibration violation, worse than the pinned 0.011 miss); n=1760 shell arm returns NaN (bracket [0, nan]). Confirms 8.1's 'accidental containment' reading: at >=1000:1 the scratch bracket's verdict is seed/n noise, not measurement.

stage2_scalability_with_correctness.verdict: CONFIRMED, with one scratch-harness fragility finding
stage2_scalability_with_correctness.evidence: n=3200: square [1.776,2.629] contains 2.0; cube [2.228,3.384] contains 3.0; A32 ident [1.486,2.492] contains; 100:1 [1.532,2.287] contains; 1000:1 [0.759,2.126] luck-contains and the production gate fires exactly as at n=1600 (margin +0.588). n=6400 square: [1.690,2.461], shell 2.087 / gp 2.063 -- both arms converging toward truth 2.0; no drift-off-truth with n anywhere.
stage2_scalability_with_correctness.finding: circle n=3200: auto-selection picks k=15 (admissible under cic's own criteria) but the SCRATCH shell_estimate (fixed max_radius=6, samples=80) returns NaN -> scratch bracket [0, nan]. The production shell arm at the same k=15 reads 1.0289 and the composed production verdict is MEASURED [0.645,1.355] containing 1.0. The prototype's fixed-window scratch bracket is n-fragile on 1-D supports; the production window selection (what 8.4 would actually integrate) is not.

stage3_production_gate_composition.verdict: claim (a) CONFIRMED; claim (b) PARTIALLY REFUTED; claim (c) REFUTED at n=1600 for the local-gp arm (the arm the 8.3 story is built on); the global-gp arm satisfies the full 8.3 table
stage3_production_gate_composition.a_1000to1_and_10000to1_gated: CONFIRMED by executing cic._detect: both rows UNDECIDED on both gp arms; READOUT_DIVERGENCE margins +0.501 and +0.594; CHAIN_ARTIFACT fires redundantly on both. Also at n=3200 (+0.588).
stage3_production_gate_composition.b_genuine_wins_survive: The named 100:1 row survives: MEASURED, margin -0.214 (n=1600) and -0.281 (n=3200), interval [1.402,2.147] contains truth. BUT 10:1 (margin +0.070) and 20:1 (margin +0.047) are killed to UNDECIDED on the local-gp arm -- the gate eats the mild-anisotropy wins 8.3's table promises as MEASURED.
stage3_production_gate_composition.c_isotropic_stays_measured: REFUTED at n=1600 for the local-gp arm: the identity square AND the isotropic control are UNDECIDED, READOUT_DIVERGENCE by margin +0.0067 (gap 0.3342 vs threshold 0.3275) -- a knife-edge miss caused by gp_local_mahalanobis's low bias (1.652) on uniform 2-D clouds at n=1600. Circle and cube stay MEASURED. At n=3200 the square recovers to MEASURED (margin -0.049). The global-gp arm keeps every isotropic case MEASURED at every n tested.
stage3_production_gate_composition.consequence: Composed with the local-gp arm as 8.3 specifies, the instrument's measured region is NON-MONOTONIC in anisotropy at n=1600: UNDECIDED at 1:1-20:1 (2-D uniforms), MEASURED at 50:1-100:1, UNDECIDED >= 200:1. No calibration violation survives anywhere (validity holds), but this is partially the owner's rejected detect-and-abstain outcome on the EASY cases. The global-Mahalanobis gp arm composition matches the 8.3 table exactly and is the composition that should be specified -- but that choice is a design decision that must be made and re-verified before integration.

stage4_bit_identity_spot_check.evidence: 26/26 fields bit-exact (float ==) across 3 battery cases (identity square, pinned 1000:1 violation row, 3-D cube) re-run with current optimized code vs the pre-optimization artifacts scale_aware_v2.json and skeptic_rescale_battery.json; plus 6/6 fields exact vs optimize_results.json at n=3200.

stage5_transition_zone_hunt.verdict: NO VIOLATION SURVIVES THE PRODUCTION GATE (0/10 rows); one NEW scratch violation found and gate-caught

Production gate: UNDECIDED (READOUT_DIVERGENCE margin +0.482 + CHAIN_ARTIFACT). Should join the 8.4 item-3 pinned regression battery alongside the 1000:1 row.
stage5_transition_zone_hunt.rotation_equivariance: Re-confirmed: at all 5 factors the rotated twin produces byte-identical output to the axis-aligned case.

measured_undecided_boundary_local_gp_arm.note: boundary is NON-MONOTONIC at n=1600; at n=3200 the low end recovers (identity margin -0.049, 100:1 margin -0.281). Global-gp arm: MEASURED-and-correct at 1:1 through 100:1, UNDECIDED >= 1000:1 (monotonic, matches the 8.3 table).

strongest_reason: The 8.3 composition claim fails in execution on its own easy cases: with the local-Mahalanobis gp arm (the arm every 8.1/8.2 bracket was built on), the real production gate turns the isotropic uniform square, its isotropic control, and 10:1-20:1 mild anisotropy into UNDECIDED at n=1600 (READOUT_DIVERGENCE, margins +0.007 to +0.070), because gp_local reads systematically low on near-isotropic 2-D clouds. No calibration violation survives the gate anywhere tested (validity is confirmed, including a newly found 500:1 scratch violation that the gate catches), so the blocker is not validity but composition: which gp arm builds the bracket must be decided (the global-Mahalanobis arm reproduces the promised 8.3 table exactly) and the battery re-verified under that choice before wiring into cic.py.
